# sendgrid_marketing_sender (Resource)

Provides a Marketing Campaigns Sender resource.

Senders are the "From" identities used when sending Marketing Campaigns. If the "From" email address is not on an authenticated domain, SendGrid sends a verification email to that address.

For more detailed information, please see the [SendGrid documentation](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/marketing-campaigns-senders).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_marketing_sender" "example" {
  nickname      = "example"
  from_email    = "marketing@example.com"
  from_name     = "Example Inc."
  reply_to      = "support@example.com"
  reply_to_name = "Example Support"
  address       = "1-1-1 Chiyoda"
  city          = "Chiyoda-ku"
  state         = "TK"
  zip           = "100-0001"
  country       = "Japan"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The physical address of the sender identity.
- `city` (String) The city of the sender identity.
- `country` (String) The country of the sender identity.
- `from_email` (String) The email address from which your recipient will receive emails.
- `from_name` (String) The name appended to the from email field. Typically your name or company name.
- `nickname` (String) A nickname for the sender identity. Not used for sending.
- `reply_to` (String) The email address to which your recipient will reply.

### Optional

- `address2` (String) Additional sender identity address information.
- `reply_to_name` (String) The name appended to the reply to email field.
- `state` (String) The state of the sender identity. SendGrid stores only the first two characters.
- `zip` (String) The zipcode of the sender identity.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the sender.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the sender is used in a campaign that is in progress. A locked sender cannot be updated or deleted.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the sender identity has been verified.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
% terraform import sendgrid_marketing_sender.example <id>
```
